description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a quiz attempt screen, handling quiz question presentation, user answer selection, and submission with feedback dialog. It manages quiz state locally and interacts with application state for score saving.

classes.name: QuizAttemptScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that represents the interface for the user to attempt a quiz, showing questions and handling answer submissions.

classes.name: _QuizAttemptScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the quiz logic, user interactions, navigation, and local state such as current question index, selected answer, and correct count.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles the submission of the user's selected answer, evaluates correctness, shows feedback dialog, updates score, and proceeds to next question or concludes the quiz.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the quiz attempt screen, including question text, options, and submission button.
